about: Items that must never be listed on The Reefer Garden preorder catalog: mostly because they are illegal to sell or possess in Arkansas, plus a few Richard does not sell on the preorder page (reason "Richard: not sold on preorder page"). The Sun Pet daily sync must skip any item whose sku is in "excluded" or "otherSunPetCodes", or whose scientific name matches a "blockedTaxa" pattern (case-insensitive regex), or whose name matches a "blockedNamePatterns" pattern (case-insensitive regex). Items needing a permit or depending on source/strain are listed under "reviewNotBlocked" for information only.

excluded.name: Albino African Clawed Frog Reg
excluded.reason: African clawed frog: amphibian not on AGFC R1.01/R1.02/R1.03 (R1.01 lists no amphibians; R1.02 lists only Pyxicephalus, Hymenochirus, Litoria/Nyctimystes/Ranoidea, Isthmura, Bombina, Ceratophrys, Trachycephalus, Osteopilus, dart frogs, Dyscophus) and not on the J1.01 approved aquatic list, so prohibited until evaluated.
excluded.citation: AGFC Code 09.01 (eff. 2026-05-02) and Addendum R1.01 Part B / R1.02 Part C / R1.03 Part B (eff. 2026-05-02): "Species not listed in Addenda R1.01, R1.02, or R1.03 are prohibited until evaluated." Species is not on any R1 list.

reviewNotBlocked.name: African Dwarf Frog Reg
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: AGFC Addendum R1.02 (Permit Required): selling requires a Wildlife Breeder/Dealer Permit (Code 09.07); buyers must acquire from a permitted dealer (Code 09.02).

reviewNotBlocked.name: Alligator Gar Reg/Med
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Alligator gar is a GAME FISH (Code 01.00-C). Code 26.20 bans selling game fish unless raised in a licensed fish-farming operation; it is not on the J1.01 approved list, so Code 35.09 requires an Unlisted Species Possession Permit for a fish dealer (Exception C covers only tropical/marine aquarium fish).

reviewNotBlocked.name: Dwarf Orange Mexican Lobster Reg
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Not prohibited (not on J1.04), but J1.01 approves only Procambarus acutus and P. clarkii. Code 39.04 says imported crayfish must meet Chapter 35.00 and J1.00, and the Code 35.09 aquarium exception covers only fish, so an Unlisted Species Possession Permit is probably needed.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Koi (all sizes)
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Approved on J1.01 only when koi come from a permitted source and were spawned and reared in the United States. Sun Pet sourcing decides.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Longnose Gar Med
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Listed on J1.01 (Approved Aquaculture Species). Confirm that Sun Pet gets them from a permitted aquaculture source and not wild-caught; that wasn't verified for this review.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Flying Gecko Med
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Ptychozoon was merged into Gekko in 2019, and R1.01 lists the genus Gekko. It is legal only if AGFC follows the current taxonomy; otherwise it is unlisted and prohibited until evaluated.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Saharan Sand Boa Med
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: R1.01 lists Eryx (small boids), and Gongylophis is generally treated as Eryx. Probably fine.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Cherry Hedge, Green Hedge (x2), Scarlet Telanthera, Tropica Alternanthera Reineckii 'Mini' TC (added 2026-10-03, out of stock)
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: The Arkansas State Plant Board lists "Alligatorweed (Alternanthera spp.)" as a noxious weed (public nuisance), and selling nursery stock containing noxious weeds is prohibited. Alternanthera is not on the 4-species Prohibited Plant List, so a Plant Board ruling decides.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Black Tropical Gar Xlg
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: Removed 2026-10-03 because legality is not verified. It is not prohibited (not on J1.04) and not a game fish (Code 01.00 lists only alligator gar among gars), but it is not on the J1.01 approved list. Code 35.09 requires an Unlisted Species Possession Permit unless Exception C applies ("marine and tropical fish commonly distributed in the aquarium trade", closed systems only). Whether a tropical gar counts is an AGFC call.

reviewNotBlocked.name: Indian Ringneck Parakeets (14 color varieties, added 2026-10-04, out of stock)
reviewNotBlocked.decidedBy: AGFC Addendum R1.02 (Permit Required): selling, breeding or importing a Rose-ringed/Ring-necked Parakeet requires a Wildlife Breeder/Dealer Permit (Code 09.07). Same treatment as African Dwarf Frog.
